Hi Anna — great to hear BlueCrest is moving forward. Quick answers and next steps below.

- Billing contact: we can switch the invoice recipient to finance@bluecrestlabs.com. Please confirm the exact payor/legal entity name to put on the invoice (company legal name and billing address).
- Tax docs: because Redwood is a US company, if BlueCrest is a non-US legal entity we typically collect a W-8BEN-E (for foreign entities) and your VAT number is also helpful for EU tax exemptions. If you have a W-8 on record, please attach; otherwise W-8BEN-E is fine. For US payors we ask for a W-9.
- Net terms / prepay: we can support net45 if Finance approves. Alternatively, we offer a 1.75% credit for full prepay for the remainder of the 12-month commitment (applies if you want to lock the capacity and avoid proration headaches). For the mid-quarter add, we can pro-rate the first invoice by daily usage from April 1 — I asked Marissa to confirm the exact proration and whether the PO can be applied to the pro-rated invoice.

Next steps I'd suggest:
1) Confirm legal entity name + billing address and whether finance@bluecrestlabs.com is an AR mailbox or shared inbox.
2) Send the signed PO file and attach W-8BEN-E (or W-9 if applicable).
3) Tell us whether you prefer net45 or full prepay; if prepay, I can route to sales for the 1.75% credit approval.

I'll leave the proration math to Marissa — copying her and Vivek for finance sign-off.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Account Executive, Enterprise
Redwood Inference

- PO: Please attach the signed PO as a PDF (we need the PO number and a contact for remittance). Once we receive the signed PO and the W-8, we will generate the first invoice and mark the account with the new billing contact.
